verdict.rationale: Quo, a business phone SaaS, publicly claims a public MCP server and has a dedicated support page. That page documents agent-accessible MCP capabilities across messages, calls, voicemail transcripts, and contacts, and a probe confirmed it exists. missing for 10: documented connection details (endpoint URL, auth/OAuth setup steps for the MCP server), independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: One-click connectors for Claude and ChatGPT, plus a public MCP server and an API your own agent can read and act on.
Connect Quo to any agent and manage your conversations, contacts, and call transcripts in plain English. No coding required.
Search your contact list, look up a specific contact’s details, add new contacts, or update existing ones just by asking.
